description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing DRM/KMS (Direct Rendering Manager / Kernel Mode Setting) contexts in a Linux graphics environment. It includes function declarations for setting up and cleaning contexts, configuring encoders, connectors, CRTCs, and retrieving object properties related to display configurations.
external_methods: uint32_t kms_get_properties(int fd, drmModeObjectProperties *props, const char *name)
published: uint32_t kms_get_properties(int fd, drmModeObjectProperties *props, const char *name)

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Creates and initializes a DRM/KMS context associated with a given file descriptor.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources held by a DRM/KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Configures the encoder for the given DRM/KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Configures the connector for the given DRM/KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Configures the CRTC (display controller) for the given DRM/KMS context.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves specific object properties by name for a DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Retrieves primary and overlay plane IDs for a given DRM/KMS context.
